name: ama-groundwork
description: Help groups identify grounded AI use cases through conversation and visual choices.

interface.shortDescription: Identify AI use cases and build a visual workbook
interface.longDescription: Work through six phases in conversation. The connector shows concise visual summaries, and each approved chapter enters a cumulative workbook and PDF. The final workbook records the problem, identified AI use cases, current and proposed workflows, human decisions and proposed implementation.
defaultPrompt: Help our group identify useful AI use cases.
